frozen.rule: Extractor rules are written against dev.jsonl and the unit tests in tests/, never against test.jsonl. Editing test.jsonl or a gold label invalidates this hash and must be recorded here with the reason.

note: Synthetic only. Split by template family so a message pattern cannot be memorised from train and scored on test. Not real WhatsApp data. dev.jsonl is the tuning split: it exists so a failing rule can be fixed without opening the test set.
